title: security: rbac-v2 - enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Kapoor
release_notes: Harden RBAC v2: KMS region pinning is now enforced for resources with residency constraints; audit logging for KMS key selection and policy evaluation improved. No API changes.
description:
Context: Customers with strict data-residency requirements have observed occasional KMS key selections that did not respect region pinning when fallback policies were applied. This PR enforces region residency constraints at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time and hardens audit logging so every KMS decision and policy fallback is recorded. Motivation: avoid silent cross-region key usage and provide clear audit trail for compliance reviews.

What this change does: - Enforce KMS region pinning during RBAC v2 policy evaluation rather than later in the key resolver. If a request would select a key outside the allowed regions, the request is denied unless an explicit override policy is present. - Add structured audit events for: policy evaluation (which rule matched), KMS key resolver decisions, and fallback reasons. Audit payloads include resource_id, requested_region, selected_key_id (when allowed), and resolution_path. - Add a new deny-with-detailed-audit mode that operators can enable for a stricter admission policy during migration. - Add unit and integration tests that simulate mixed-region keystores and fallback chains. - Update docs and Linear tickets referenced in the changelog.

Files of interest: high-level changes in rbac evaluator, kms resolver, audit event schema, migration tooling for existing policies, and improved logs for private deployments.

Testing & rollout: - Unit tests + RBAC integration tests covering region matching and explicit overrides. - End-to-end tests in perf-canary and a small internal Dedicated cluster. - Feature gated behind 'rbac_v2_kms_residency_hardening' flag. Rollout plan: enable audit-logging first (collect data for 48h), enable deny-with-detailed-audit mode in a canary org, then flip enforcement across release-window.

Migration notes: - Existing policies that relied on implicit fallback will be audited during the initial collection window. Operators should run the supplied migration script to flag policies needing an explicit override. - No data re-encryption is performed; this only affects selection of KMS keys at request time.

Checklist:
- [x] Enforce region pinning in RBAC v2 evaluator
- [x] Emit structured audit events for KMS decisions
- [x] Add unit + integration tests
- [x] Doc updates and Linear links
- [x] Feature flag and rollout plan

Related: Linear ENG-2741 implements the migration script and collection dashboards. SUP-1287 is the customer support thread that triggered the investigation.

merge_commit_message:
squash: security(rbac): enforce kms region pinning + audit logging hardening

Enforce KMS region residency at RBAC evaluation time and add structured audit events for policy and resolver decisions. Migration tooling + docs.
notes_for_ops: Operators: enable rbac_v2_kms_residency_hardening feature flag in staging, run cmd/migrations/kms_residency_audit --collect for 48h, review flagged policies before enabling deny mode. See docs/security/rbac_v2_kms_region_pin.md for guidance.
security_impact: High - changes admission policies for KMS key selection. Auditing improved to provide traceability. Recommend gradual rollout and chart alerting for denied KMS requests.
user_impact: Most customers unaffected; orgs with mixed-region keys may observe denied requests once enforcement is enabled. We provide explicit override flow for operators.
notes: Backported critical test fixes to release/2026.02 in a follow-up PR. Monitored in canary for 72h post-merge.
